channel.title: US Top News and Analysis
channel.description: CNBC is the world leader in business news and real-time financial market coverage. Find fast, actionable information.

item.title: Dow tumbles 900 points as losses accelerate ahead of Fed decision: Live updates
item.description: The Dow is coming off its third straight winning day.

item.title: Trump says U.S. will give Iran a 'beating' after surprise attack
item.description: Centcom in a post on X said that the attack originated from Iran, but all missiles were intercepted.

item.title: Oil prices jump 7% after Trump says U.S. will hit Iran hard
item.description: Oil rose sharply amid renewed tensions in the Middle East after Iran launched an attack on U.S. forces using ballistic missiles.

item.title: Warren, Schiff urge SEC to probe Trump Media's paid service giving faster access to Trump's posts
item.description: Trump has frequently posted policy announcements or other newsworthy information on Truth Social that have sent global markets hurtling up or down.

item.title: Microsoft is set to report earnings after the bell, and all eyes are on its spending plans
item.description: Investors are looking to see if Microsoft follows Alphabet in raising its capital spending plans

item.title: Caterpillar is downgraded on growing data center buildout backlash. The shares are falling
item.description: Caterpillar has performed like a tech stock this year as investors bet on ever-growing demand for construction equipment from the computing buildout.

item.title: Nike was once China's sneaker king. Here's why its sales have fallen 30%
item.description: China was once Nike's fastest-growing region but the company has lost relevance among young consumers and ceded market share to smaller, domestic brands.

item.title: Meta reports second-quarter results after the close
item.description: Meta continues to see healthy growth from online ads, but investors are looking for more clarity on the company's plans to diversify.

item.title: JPMorgan, Schwab and UBS manage millions in Trump's $858 million investment portfolio
item.description: JPMorgan, Schwab, UBS and Stephens Inc. are among the firms that have managed Trump's fortune in accounts worth at least $858 million, a CNBC analysis found.

item.title: Secret Service 'illegally' surveilled Comey in Trump ‘8647’ threat case: Court filing
item.description: Ex-FBI Director James Comey says he's the subject of vindictive prosecution for posting on Instagram of a photo of seashells forming the numbers "8647."

item.title: Elon Musk's xAI sues Minnesota over law to ban 'nudify' apps
item.description: Elon Musk's xAI, now owned by SpaceX, is challenging a law that would ban so-called nudify apps in Minnesota

item.title: FIFA is embroiled in a $20 billion World Cup controversy. Here's what's going on
item.description: UEFA – European soccer's governing body – accused FIFA of "crossing a line" and said the tournament is not its to sell.

item.title: Humana tops quarterly estimates, maintains profit outlook as medical costs stay in line
item.description: Humana maintained its 2026 adjusted profit outlook of at least $9 per share, which some analysts called a "disappointment" amid high expectations for insurers.

item.title: Procter & Gamble revenue misses estimates as volume stays unchanged
item.description: Procter & Gamble reported quarterly earnings per share that topped Wall Street's estimates, but its revenue fell short of expectations.

item.title: Cyclospora outbreak tied to Taco Bell will steal the spotlight from Yum Brands' earnings
item.description: Wall Street is projecting a strong second quarter for Yum Brands, but investors' focus will be on updates related to the cyclospora outbreak tied to Taco Bell.

item.title: How a 40-year-old father launched a $1.6 billion-a-year meat snacks empire from a bankrupt Wisconsin business
item.description: Jack Link turned a bankruptcy into an opportunity to build a beef jerky empire. Four decades later, Link Snacks brings in more than $1 billion in annual sales.

item.title: Warren probes Pentagon program to hire highly paid private sector workers
item.description: Sen. Elizabeth Warren, D-Mass., said she is concerned about a Pentagon program to pay high salaries to Wall Street recruits.

item.title: There's a big rotation happening in the market. Two stocks to watch with attractive charts
item.description: Todd Gordon breaks down the rotation taking place in the market along with the technicals of two names.

item.title: Tim Cook’s last earnings call comes at momentous time for Apple with stock at record
item.description: Apple just hit a $5 trillion market cap for the first time, but CEO Tim Cook still has plenty of concerns to address on his final earnings call at the helm.

item.title: Why shareholders are suing Novo Nordisk over next-generation weight-loss drug
item.description: Investors claim Novo Nordisk misled the market about CagriSema's tolerability, after disappointing clinical trial results wiped billions off its market cap.

item.title: Jim Cramer says Seagate is the ‘key to this market’ after blowout earnings
item.description: Jim Cramer said investors should look to Seagate Technology as a barometer of whether the AI infrastructure trade can regain momentum on Wednesday.

item.title: Chime is expanding into investing — here's what you need to know
item.description: Known for its banking products, Chime now lets users invest without leaving the app. Who's it for?

item.title: YES Network, MSG Networks to exit Gotham app for DAZN streaming service
item.description: The regional sports networks that air games for local New York and New Jersey teams, including MLB's Yankees and NHL's Rangers, will have a new streaming home.

item.title: OpenAI's rogue agent compromised a customer at a second tech firm: Reuters
item.description: The intrusion at Hugging Face, carried out by an agent OpenAI was testing, drew global attention and evoked science-fiction scenarios of AI run amok.

item.title: Audi continues U.S. product push with three-row Q9 SUV
item.description: Audi sales have struggled in the U.S. over the last several quarters. The brand has been hit by tariffs and a market shift away from EVs. New product may help.

item.title: Does the 4% retirement rule still work? New research points to another strategy to maximize income
item.description: When it comes to retirement income, diversifying with partial annuities may help make nest eggs last, new research finds.

item.title: Ukraine has found a new pressure point in Russia’s wartime economy
item.description: Ukraine's drone attacks on Russia's biggest online retailer, Wildberries, have ratcheted up the pressure on Moscow's wartime economy.

item.title: BMW to cut several thousand jobs in latest blow to German auto sector
item.description: BMW said on ⁠Wednesday it will cut several thousand jobs in Germany by the end of 2027 under ​a voluntary redundancy program.

item.title: UBS CEO says the AI pullback is healthy — but there’s a bigger risk investors should watch
item.description: The Swiss banking gian reported pre-tax profits of $3.6 billion for the quarter, as CEO Sergio Ermotti warned of geopolitical volatility ahead.

item.title: SK Hynix shares tank as exponential earnings growth fails to satisfy AI-charged expectations
item.description: SK Hynix shares fell as exponential profit and revenue growth failed to meet analysts' lofty expectations for a darling of the artificial intelligence sector.
